convert_timesformer_checkpoint: convert a TimeSformer checkpoint from the original repository to Hugging Face transformers format
get_timesformer_config: get a TimesformerConfig for a given model name with correct num_frames, num_labels, and label mappings
rename_key: rename a checkpoint key from the original TimeSformer naming convention to Hugging Face naming
convert_state_dict: convert an original TimeSformer state dict to Hugging Face Timesformer state dict format
run_timesformer_conversion_cli: run the conversion script via argparse CLI to convert a TimeSformer checkpoint and save it locally or push to the hub
